nina: quick heads-up — Ceres customer LoRA merge produces shorter replies and elevated early EOS. Repro + short metrics below. @paul can you sanity-check merge path?

paul: numbers? sample prompt?

nina: 40-example smoke: top3_mass 0.34 -> 0.52, median_len 19 -> 10, embed_cosine 0.986 -> 0.958. Example: billing prompt drops to 5 tokens and ends with </s> at token 3. Runtime adapter application is fine. Merge command used: `python tools/merge_lora.py --base models/redwood/v2.1 --lora /cust/ceres_v1.safetensors --out /tmp/ceres-merged.safetensors` (default folds to fp16).

paul: that smells like fp16 folding sharpening softmax. Did you try `--keep-fp32`?

nina: yes — re-merged with `--keep-fp32` and then quantized manually. Metrics improved: top3_mass 0.36, median_len 16, embed_cosine 0.973. Not perfect but much closer.

rachel: any sign token-embedding or lm_head shift? small param diff?

nina: ran a lightweight param diff between (base+runtime-adapter) and (base+merged). Top diffs: transformer.h.7.mlp.fc1 mean-diff 0.014, wte.weight mean-diff 0.008, lm_head.weight mean-diff 0.005. Token emb showing non-zero drift.

paul: hmm — drift in wte is worrying. Could be merge-signature writing into embed slice or numeric folding effects. Two actions: (1) quick dry-run mapping_report from merge script to confirm keys map correctly, (2) add a merge-time guard to fail if wte.mean_diff > 0.005.

merge-bot: queued job 1776543220: dry-merge -> mapping_report. Output: mapping looks consistent; no ambiguous vendor keys.

paul: then likely numeric folding contributes. Plan: change default merge to preserve fp32 when merging into models where token-emb/lm_head delta > threshold, add post-merge param-diff check, and include a 10-example mini-evalpack in onboarding artifacts.

nina: I'll prepare the mini-evalpack and notify the customer. ETA 2h. If they sign off, we'll canary the merged artifact with preserve-fp32+post-quant.

rachel: please also add a unit test that fails if a merge writes nontrivial changes to embedding indices.

paul: agreed. I'll open a small PR to tools/merge_lora.py to add the guard and default change.

nina: thanks team — will post the evalpack here once ready. :thumbsup:
